:::::: card
## <i class="bi bi-question-circle-fill icon"></i> The Challenge

::: conetent-text
The goal of this project is to create an interactive asset map of community anchor institutions in Kansas. By understanding resource density and accessibility state-wide, communities will be better equipped to identify patterns in health, social, and economic disparities. 
:::
